events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, known as Sting, the iconic frontman of The Police and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, which track of his defines your day?

events.title: iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music players with its '1,000 songs in your pocket' promise.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember life before the iPod? It's 25 years since Apple dropped this game-changer, putting 1,000 songs in our pockets. What was the first album you loaded on yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the 1962 London premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's Global James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since Dr. No hit cinemas. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, singer-songwriter, and peace activist, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius has given us endless laughs.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing a diverse range of styles.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. An absolute masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your standout track from this legendary double LP?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, 35 years since we lost a true icon. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: A true classic turns 61 today! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' was unleashed on the world on this date in 1965, a pivotal album that pushed boundaries. Which track still stands out for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, the visionary co-founder of The Beatles and an enduring voice for peace.

angles.name: Lennon Death Tribute
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to echo through time, reminding us to Imagine.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie, the influential and innovative musician, singer-songwriter, and actor, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman on what would have been his 80th birthday. David Bowie's artistry redefined music and culture. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll and one of the most significant cultural icons of the 20th century, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today, forever changing the face of music. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: James Patrick Page, the legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page's 83rd
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin legend still inspires generations of musicians. What's his greatest riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Roderick David Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart's 82nd
angles.copy: Raise a glass for Sir Rod Stewart, who turns 82 today! A true rock and roll legend with a voice that's instantly recognisable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic lead singer of the iconic ska band Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs' 66th
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the Nutty Boy himself, Suggs! The Madness frontman has given us some of the most memorable tracks of the 80s. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Paul Antony Young, the English singer known for his smooth blue-eyed soul hits of the 1980s, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young's 71st
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! The voice behind some classic 80s hits. What's your favourite track from the blue-eyed soul legend?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary American country music singer, songwriter, and actress Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly's 81st
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the iconic Dolly Parton! A true queen of country and pop, her music and spirit are simply timeless. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Gary Barlow, the acclaimed English singer, songwriter, and lead vocalist of Take That, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow's 56th
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, what's your favourite Gary moment?
